requiredEnv.name: LINK_API_KEY
requiredEnv.description: Bearer token for CLI/Deck run reconciliation

requiredEnv.name: LINK_ADMIN_KEY
requiredEnv.description: Bearer token for admin entitlements API (same value as Vercel LINK_ADMIN_KEY)

requiredEnv.name: CLERK_ISSUER
requiredEnv.description: Clerk JWT issuer for org policy routes

requiredEnv.name: CLERK_JWKS_URL
requiredEnv.description: Clerk JWKS URL for JWT verification

requiredEnv.name: PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
requiredEnv.description: Optional; only if Link verifies Paddle webhooks directly

notes: Railway injects PORT; do not set LINK_BIND in production unless debugging.
